options.A: They all occurred in Nazi Germany during World War I.
options.B: They are all forms of residential segregation.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about East Asia's industrial regions is true?

options.A: Japan has a rich natural resource base.
options.B: China lacks natural resources but has a massive labor force.
options.D: Taiwan lacks industrial enterprise and an educated workforce.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - China is industrializing rapidly.

questions.stem_text: Which one of the statements below correctly describes immigrants living in Europe?

options.A: Most find citizenship easy to get in host countries.
options.B: Muslims immigrants from North Africa are well integrated in France.
options.C: Immigrants to European cities rarely bring their families.
options.D: They are usually restricted to certain neighborhoods.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - They are usually restricted to certain neighborhoods.
